description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY - never registered in production. A component that exists so the SLOT-ENGINE suites have a stable host: pp_render_style_vars(), style_component, invalid_style_slot, the friendly-error slot context and the envelope findings are all about the ENGINE, not about any particular component, but each test has to name a real component as its fixture. See tests/fixtures/components/ppfixture/README.md for why this exists and when it is deleted.

id.description: Stable band id, so the fixture behaves like any other band at the write path.

title.description: Gates the heading slots' `applies_when`, so the conditional-slot suites keep a real condition to exercise.

theme.description: A tone prop, kept because the theme-variant and friendly-error suites exercise enum coercion and the legacy `--dark` output name.

background_image.description: Gates the background slots' `applies_when`. Declares `format: image_url` because the registry invariant requires every canonical image-shaped prop to (ActionsTest::testEveryImageShapedSchemaPropDeclaresImageUrlFormat) - a fixture that broke a registry invariant would fail the very suites it hosts. Kept as a TEXT url rather than an attachment id on purpose: this fixture stands in for a v1 component, and v1 is what the slot engine serves.

items.description: Gates the item slots' `applies_when`, and makes the component composable (every composable component must declare a required prop - SchemaValidationTest pins that invariant).

--ppfixture-padding-top.description: Band padding above. An UNCONDITIONAL slot, so the suites always have one that applies.

--ppfixture-bg.description: Band background. TYPED `gradient` deliberately: the gradient type has exactly two consumers left in the theme and the friendly-error suites exercise its rejection messages.

--ppfixture-radius.description: Band corner radius. An inert default, so an unset fixture band renders square.

--ppfixture-max-width.description: Band cap. TYPED `length-or-none` deliberately: it is the only slot type with a keyword alternative, and the type-rejection suites need one.

--ppfixture-heading-size.description: Heading size. CONDITIONAL on `title`, so the inert-slot advisory has a condition to report.

--ppfixture-bg-position.description: Background focal point. CONDITIONAL on `background_image`, which is the shape that lets a suite store a slot whose condition is UNMET and read the advisory back.

--ppfixture-heading-margin-bottom.description: Heading rhythm. The BAND-FUSING knob (#584): a suite asserts style_component accepts it and rejects a non-length value, so the fixture needs a length slot whose job is spacing rather than size.

--ppfixture-heading-accent-color.description: Accent ink. A SECOND colour slot, because the engine suites exercise accepting `transparent` and a var() reference on one colour slot while rejecting an unknown token on another.

--ppfixture-image-size.description: A SIZING length slot with a bare literal default (not a token). The suites assert a token reference is REJECTED here - that rejection only has meaning on a slot whose default is a literal, which is why this is not folded into the padding slots.

--ppfixture-gap.description: A strip-rhythm gap. Kept distinct from the padding slots because the persistence suites write a gap and a padding in the same call and assert both survive the merge.

--ppfixture-overlay-bg.description: The scrim over a background image. THE INERT-SLOT WORKHORSE: its condition (`background_image` present) is the one a suite deliberately leaves UNMET so the accepted write carries an `inert_slot` advisory naming the dead slot and the unmet clause. That shape needs a slot whose condition can be false while the band still renders, which is why this is separate from the bg-position slot.

--ppfixture-number-font.description: A font-family slot. THE ONLY `font-family`-TYPED SLOT LEFT once stats retired: the grammar suites need one to exercise quoted stacks, var() token references, and the CSS-comment-opener rejection (a value like `serif /*` must be refused as invalid_style_value and must still RESTORE without blocking, per ruling 2). Defaults to `inherit`, which is what the retired --stats-number-font declared.
